caption: The drawing features a single large ceramic pitcher positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The pitcher is rendered in grayish-brown tones with a glossy, dark brown interior visible at the top. It has a wide mouth with a small pouring spout and a sturdy, rounded body that tapers at the neck before flaring outward. The handle is attached on one side, extending from the upper rim to the midsection of the pot. A decorative floral motif in deep blue adorns one side of the pitcher, involving several large flower shapes with petals and leaves arranged horizontally around the midsection. The lighting suggests a subtle sheen on the pitcher’s surface, emphasizing its rounded form, and the lines and shadows indicate the contours and texture of the ceramic material. There is a small, cursive signature in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Stoneware Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
